title: Sell Mineral Rights in Burns, WY
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Burns, WY | Laramie County
metaDescription: Burns, WY sits over the northern DJ Basin in Laramie County, close to the historic Silo Field. Get a straight read on your mineral interest before selling.
heroLead: Burns sits inside the broader footprint of the Silo Field, the discovery that proved horizontal Niobrara development could work this far north in the DJ Basin back in the 1990s.
intro: Laramie County's oil history out here is tied directly to Silo, a field that predates the modern horizontal shale boom but demonstrated the productive potential of the Niobrara chalk decades before Colorado's Wattenberg field made the play famous nationally. That early activity means Burns-area minerals have a longer recorded lease history than a lot of newer plays elsewhere in the state.

If your family's interest ties back to that original Silo-era leasing, or to more recent horizontal development in the same footprint, I want your actual documentation in hand before I give you a number, because production history here spans multiple technology generations.

sections.heading: Silo Field's layered history
paragraphs: Silo was developed initially with vertical wells targeting the Niobrara chalk's natural fracture systems, then saw renewed interest as horizontal drilling and modern completion techniques improved recovery decades later. That layered history means a Burns-area tract could carry royalty history from more than one development era, sometimes with gaps in between when the field went quiet.
I check the full lease timeline for your specific section, not only current activity, since older production history still matters to how I price your interest.

sections.heading: What determines value near Burns
paragraphs: Distance from active or historically productive wellbores, your trailing royalty statements if you have them, and current DJ Basin activity levels all factor in. Horizontal oil plays like this one move with commodity prices, so I peg any number to recent comparable trades and current market conditions rather than a fixed formula.

sections.heading: Confirming your title
paragraphs: Laramie County keeps thorough records, and I pull your chain of title directly from the recorder's office before quoting anything, so you know exactly what you're holding.

faqs.question: Is Silo Field still producing?
faqs.answer: Parts of the field have seen renewed horizontal development over the years. I'll check the current status of your specific section.

faqs.question: My family's lease is decades old. Is it still valid?
faqs.answer: Most old leases lapse without continued production or new drilling. I'll check whether yours is still held or has expired.

faqs.question: How does the Niobrara play here compare to Colorado's?
faqs.answer: Same target formation, but the northern DJ Basin in Wyoming produces differently and has seen less dense development than Weld County, Colorado.
